The entire grid is \(6\) squares wide and \(4\) squares tall, so its area is

\[
6\cdot 4=24.
\]

The shaded hexagon is obtained by removing four congruent right triangles from the corners of the grid. Each triangle has legs of length \(2\), so each has area

\[
\frac12(2)(2)=2.
\]

Thus the total unshaded corner area is \(4\cdot2=8\). Therefore, the shaded area is

\[
24-8=16.
\]

\boxed{16\text{ square units}}
